sections.title: Responsible Data Usage
sections.content: NexRide collects only the data strictly necessary for the safe execution of your journey: name, contact phone number for coordination with the driver, and billing data processed via certified banking channels.

sections.title: Banking Security & Encryption
sections.content: All financial transactions are processed through Stripe, one of the world leaders in payment security, ensuring that your card data never resides on our servers.

sections.title: Location Management
sections.content: The vehicle's location is monitored exclusively during the service to ensure passenger safety and route efficiency, with this data being deleted after the legal retention period.

sections.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
sections.content: As a user, you have the full right to access, rectify, or request the permanent deletion of your data. Our commitment is to total transparency on how your information helps us serve you better.

sections.title: Nature of Agreement
sections.content: By using NexRide, you are hiring a professional transport brokerage service. We guarantee that all drivers in our network possess the legal licenses required by Portuguese legislation (RNAAT/TVDE).

sections.title: Conduct & Responsibilities
sections.content: We commit to providing a punctual and safe service. In return, we ask the user to maintain respectful conduct and provide accurate flight data for airport transfers.

sections.title: Flexibility & Cancellations
sections.content: We understand that plans change. We offer free cancellation up to 24h before the trip. Late cancellations may be subject to administrative fees to compensate for driver availability.

sections.title: Conflict Resolution
sections.content: Any unforeseen event will be treated with maximum priority by our support team. We always favor friendly and direct resolution through our 24/7 support center.
